description: This file is a JavaScript source script used for generating C# API interface code from API documentation. It processes API definitions, types, and documentation to produce C# interface, class, enum, and method code, specifically for .NET/C# bindings.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Generates a C# code file with class, interface, enum, or method definitions, including documentation comments and XML documentation rendering.

methods.name: renderClass
methods.description: Renders a C# interface class from a documentation class, including its members and documentation.

methods.name: renderModelType
methods.description: Generates a C# class definition from a documentation type, handling properties and nested types.

methods.name: renderEnum
methods.description: Creates a C# enum from a list of string literals.

methods.name: renderOptionType
methods.description: Generates a C# class for API options, including constructors and properties.

methods.name: toArgumentName
methods.description: Converts a parameter name to a valid C# argument name, prefixing with '@' if needed.

methods.name: toMemberName
methods.description: Converts a member or parameter name to a C#-friendly name, adding 'I' prefix for interfaces and 'Async' suffix for async methods.

methods.name: toTitleCase
methods.description: Converts a string to TitleCase (first letter uppercase).

methods.name: renderConstructors
methods.description: Creates constructor overloads for a C# class, including copy constructors.

methods.name: renderMemberDoc
methods.description: Renders XML documentation comments for a class member.

methods.name: renderMember
methods.description: Renders a class member (property, method, event) with documentation and proper C# syntax.

methods.name: getPropertyOverloads
methods.description: Generates property overloads for different JSON property names or types.

methods.name: generateNameDefault
methods.description: Generates a default name for a type or member, handling enums and special cases.

methods.name: generateEnumNameIfApplicable
methods.description: Determines if a type can be represented as an enum based on its union of string literals.

methods.name: renderMethod
methods.description: Renders a method signature in C#, including async handling, parameters, and documentation.

methods.name: translateType
methods.description: Translates a documentation type into a C# type string, handling generics, arrays, dictionaries, and special types.

methods.name: registerModelType
methods.description: Registers a type as a model type for code generation, avoiding duplicates and certain primitive types.

methods.name: printArgDoc
methods.description: Prints XML documentation for method parameters.

methods.name: toAsync
methods.description: Converts a method name to its async version by appending 'Async'.

methods.name: rewriteSuggestedOptionsName
methods.description: Rewrites certain suggested options class names to a common name.
